title: Find Nuclei plate manifest (v1)
description: A small JSON file that maps every well, field, plane, timepoint and channel of an HCS plate (Opera Phenix / Harmony or Yokogawa CellVoyager) to its image file. The Find Nuclei viewer builds it from the plate's index (Index.idx.xml or Index.xml for Harmony, the .mlf measurement log for Yokogawa) and opens the plate from it. Full guide: https://find-nuclei.github.io/docs/guides/opera-phenix-plates
x-stability-note: UNSTABLE: this format is published for transparency and tooling, not as a stable contract. It is still converging alongside the Find Nuclei platform and may change without preserving backward compatibility until that ships. Pin a copy rather than assuming a manifest that validates today will validate later.

partial.description: true when only the start of the index was read: exceptions and missing images after that point are not listed. Save plate manifest in the viewer reads the whole index first and writes false.

instrument.description: Instrument name, for example "CV8000 AZ01" or "Phenix". Optional.

schema.description: XML namespace of the index, for example http://www.perkinelmer.com/PEHH/HarmonyV5.

imagesUrl.description: Folder holding the index and its TIFFs. A relative address resolves against the manifest's own address. null: read from a local folder, or from the manifest's own folder when opened by URL.

indexFile.description: File name of the index inside imagesUrl, usually Index.idx.xml.

etag.description: ETag of the index when it was read, or null.

lastModified.description: Last-Modified of the index when it was read, or null.

type.description: Plate type from the index, for example "384 PerkinElmer CellCarrier Ultra".

imageSize.description: Size of one field image in pixels.

pixelSize.description: Size of one pixel in metres.

zStep.description: Metres between consecutive planes, or null with a single plane.

pattern.description: File name of one image, relative to imagesUrl, with {name} or {name:width} placeholders. Names: row, col, field, plane, timepoint, channel, sk (timepoint + 1), rowname (A, B ... AA) and action (the channel's action). Width pads with zeros. null: every image is listed in exceptions with its url.

planesPerChannel.description: Optional. Planes the files hold per channel ID; planes is what is shown.

action.description: Optional. Action number in the file name, for pattern name {action} (Yokogawa).

type.description: Channel type from the index, for example Fluorescence or Brightfield.

wells.description: Wells present on the plate as [row, column], counting from 1, sorted by row then column.

fieldPositions.description: Field position in metres, keyed by field ID.

exceptions.description: Images that do not follow the pattern or are not Ok, sorted by row, col, field, plane, timepoint, channel. An image without an entry is at its pattern name.

state.description: Image state from the index. Anything other than Ok shows as black.

url.description: File name relative to imagesUrl, when it differs from the pattern.
